title: Anyone else dream of this place? Or something similar?
content: [https://fb.watch/rM69Y-TNJW/](https://fb.watch/rM69Y-TNJW/) [https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=297110219874938&ref=sharing](https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=297110219874938&ref=sharing) For some, seeing this come up on your feed might make you think its a fun play area. But I'll tell you what, when I saw it, I almost had a mini-panic attack. I've had literal nightmares of this place, trapped in an endless maze of twisting yarn or plastic tunnels. and I never knew it was even real. I swear, this thing has to be a Backroom somewhere...
